text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting! I'm Smart Falcon! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As you know, my goal's to become a top 
Umadol—an Umamusume who races,
dances, and
brings sparkly hope to
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And I'm going to work hard every day to
make that happen! I can't wait to get up
on that dazzling stage and give
everyone my best
performance! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
